where-derivatives-fail.alt: Four small graphs. A corner: y = |x| + 0.5, a V shape with slope minus 1 on the left of 0 and 1 on the right. A cusp: y = x to the two-thirds, a sharp point at the origin where the slopes become infinitely steep in opposite directions. A vertical tangent: y = cube root of (x minus 1), with a vertical tangent line x = 1 drawn dashed. A jump: a line ending with a closed dot at (1, 1.5) and restarting with an open dot at (1, 0). The first three are continuous but not differentiable at the marked point; the jump is not continuous, so not differentiable.
